summary_1line: Hanuman surveys Lanka by moonlight, observing its people, wealth, and nightly life, yet fails to find any sign of Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands on a high rooftop in Lanka under a brilliant full moon, scanning the glittering city for any sign of Sita.
The full moon rises over Lanka, silver light pouring across palaces, elephants, warriors, and sleeping couples in the night.
Hidden in shadow, Hanuman watches through palace windows where jeweled women sleep beside their lords amid golden halls.
